discovery_evidence.attempt2_gate_delta: 0; frozen candidate SHA identical to baseline

code_observation.current_gate: requires at least two teacher pairs and returns a candidate only if every fitted D4/geometry/color-map model yields one identical output
code_observation.hypothesis: A unique plurality among the already train-fitting model predictions may produce useful second-attempt candidates even when strict all-model unanimity abstains.

candidate_change.rule: Keep the existing minimum of two teacher pairs. From predict_pool, propose only when one output grid has a unique highest support of at least 2 fitted model configurations; on ties or support below 2, abstain. The adapter may use it only as the existing provisional second attempt when distinct from attempt_1. Do not change HDS truth status, first attempt, or reasons.
candidate_change.scope: single generic transformation generator; no new operator family, no task-id/hash branch, no answer map, no fixed output

acceptance_gate: Adopt only if confirm pass@2 has positive net gain over 100 grids, no baseline pass@2 regression, pass@1 unchanged, schema valid, and identical-input candidate runs have byte-identical submission SHA. Otherwise reject and do not submit.
